name: Archival / Historical
description: Aged cream paper, sepia ink, oxblood accent and serif documentary type; reads as documents, maps and press clippings with slow dissolves.

tokens.texture: Paper grain (multiply), faint foxing and halftone for photographs
tokens.spacing: --u = 1% of short side; --gap; safe-area insets per format

motion.personality: Measured and documentary: slow dissolves, drift, gentle settles
motion.notes: No overshoot. Treat motion as a camera over a surface, not objects performing.

validation.evidence: Contrast ratios computed from the stylesheet hex values with src/pipeline/colorscience.py (WCAG 2.x), 2026-11-02. Not yet used in a rendered project.
